questions.question: Why did Reuben lose his birthright?
What happened to the eastern tribes because of their unfaithfulness?
options: A famine drove them from their land
Their flocks and herds were all lost
They were taken into exile by Assyria
They were scattered among the Moabites
questions.answer: They were taken into exile by Assyria

questions.question: The Reubenites and Gadites cried out to God in battle and were helped because they trusted him.
